name: MoveMouseToImage
label: Move Mouse to Image
description: Moves the mouse cursor to the center of a specified image on the screen using template matching.

fields.name: ImagePath
fields.label: Image to Move Mouse To
fields.description: The path to the image file to locate.

fields.name: SimilarityThreshold
fields.label: Similarity Threshold
fields.description: The similarity threshold for image matching (0.0 to 1.0). Default is 0.9.

fields.name: SearchArea
fields.label: Search Area
fields.description: The search area (Left, Top, Right, Bottom). Leave empty for full screen.

fields.name: MouseMovementStyle
fields.label: Mouse Movement Style
fields.description: Specifies how the mouse should move to the target position.

selectOptions.label: Instant
selectOptions.description: Moves the mouse instantly to the target position.

selectOptions.label: With animation (low speed)
selectOptions.description: Moves the mouse with low speed animation.

selectOptions.label: With animation (normal speed)
selectOptions.description: Moves the mouse with normal speed animation.

selectOptions.label: With animation (high speed)
selectOptions.description: Moves the mouse with high speed animation.

fields.name: Occurrence
fields.label: Occurrence
fields.description: Which occurrence of the image to find (1-based index).

fields.name: SendClickAfterMoving
fields.label: Send a Click After Moving Mouse
fields.description: If true, sends a click after moving the mouse.

fields.name: ClickType
fields.label: Click Type
fields.description: The type of click to perform after moving the mouse.

selectOptions.label: Left click
selectOptions.description: Performs a left mouse button click.

selectOptions.label: Right click
selectOptions.description: Performs a right mouse button click.

selectOptions.label: Left button down
selectOptions.description: Presses the left mouse button down.

selectOptions.label: Left button up
selectOptions.description: Releases the left mouse button up.

selectOptions.label: Right button down
selectOptions.description: Presses the right mouse button down.

selectOptions.label: Right button up
selectOptions.description: Releases the right mouse button up.

selectOptions.label: Middle click
selectOptions.description: Performs a middle mouse button click.

fields.name: WaitForImage
fields.label: Wait for Image to Appear
fields.description: If true, waits for the image to appear before moving the mouse.

fields.name: FailTimeout
fields.label: Fail Timeout
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the image to appear.

fields.name: OffsetX
fields.label: Offset X
fields.description: Horizontal offset from the center of the image.

fields.name: OffsetY
fields.label: Offset Y
fields.description: Vertical offset from the center of the image.

fields.name: SearchMode
fields.label: Search Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to search the entire screen or a specified region.

selectOptions.label: Entire screen
selectOptions.description: Searches the entire screen for the image.

selectOptions.label: Specified subregion
selectOptions.description: Searches a specific subregion of the screen for the image.

fields.name: SearchSubregion
fields.label: Search Subregion
fields.description: Coordinates of the subregion to search (X1, Y1, X2, Y2).

fields.name: IsFound
fields.label: Is Found
fields.description: Returns true if the image was found and mouse was moved.

fields.name: FoundPosition
fields.label: Found Position
fields.description: The position where the image was found (X,Y).
